new.story: A 2002 British penny with Queen Elizabeth II on the front. The other side shows a crowned portcullis with chains — the symbol of the House of Commons — and the words ONE PENNY.
new.notes: Blind double-read. ELIZABETH II D·G REG·F·D / 2002 read from enlargement. Denomination per owner's flip label (1 Penny); obverse-only photo, copper color consistent with 1p/2p. Flip-ratio measurement inconclusive, not used as evidence.

source: NOID_UnitedKingdom_2002_1Penny_obv.jpg (owner chat 2026-10-13); owner's flip labeled 'United Kingdom 2002 / 1 Penny'
